_note: What Shige, the vegetable grower of Minamino, says when the farmer talks to him (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction, gift_items his own answers to a keepsake and to dishes. He has no hearts. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: A day without weeding! The radishes can mind themselves until tomorrow.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Nana wants something from every stall. I said one thing. We'll see who wins.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: I put the first sweet potatoes of the year on the moon table. A grower's thank-you.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Good soil, kind rain, and a girl who grows faster than my cucumbers. A fine year.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Back for more advice? Water at dawn, not at noon. That's all I've got.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: If you see Nana by the pond, tell her supper's at six. She never hears me.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: You're the one who took over the old farm! Shige. I grow greens down here, for the store and the teahouse.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Fellow grower, eh? If your leaves yellow, come ask. Soil talks, if you know how to listen.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Rain! Saves me forty trips to the well. I'm fixing hoe handles today.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Turnips first, always. Quick to grow, quick to sell, and the slugs like them less.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Cucumbers want water morning and night in this heat. And a stick to climb.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Crows got my tomatoes again. Nana says we should make a scarecrow that looks like me.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Daikon's in. Kiku will want some for her pickles. She always does.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Nothing grows now but plans. I spend the evenings deciding next year's rows.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: My wife planted those gardens. I just keep them the way she liked. Nana helps.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Sayo buys my greens every morning. Says they're the only ones that don't wilt by noon.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: The little shrine by the lane is for the water. Kiku keeps it. Good to bow when you pass.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Now that's a fine one! I can't grow these as well as you. Teach me sometime.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Thanks! This'll go in tonight's pot.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Oh, for me? Thank you.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Ah, that's more Nana's sort of thing. I'll pass it on.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: A stone? I dig hundreds of those out of the beds each spring. No thank you.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: One's plenty for today. Don't spoil us.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: A moon lantern! Nana's mother used to hang one every fall. ...Thank you. Truly.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Hearty and hot! Nana and I will fight over this one.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: A cooked dish! Saves me burning supper again. Thanks.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Oh, a dish. Thanks, we'll have it tonight.

lines.speaker: shige
lines.text: Too sweet for me. Nana will be thrilled, though.
